name: Publix Grocery Distribution Center Boynton Beach FL

fieldNotes.truckGate: SW divided-boulevard entrance off Park Ridge Blvd with a sliding/swing gate and fencing across the inbound truck lanes; confirmed in Street View (a parked Publix trailer sits just inside).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small tan peaked-roof guard booth in the entrance median beside the lanes (~1-vehicle footprint), visible in both Street View and zoom-20 satellite at ~26.5417,-80.0806.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron/yard inside the gate before the dock faces provides interior holding.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Divided entrance drive plus deep interior yard easily holds a 3+ truck queue before docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gated entrance point handles both in and out via the divided (median-split) driveway.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound lanes from satellite lane markings at the gate; medium confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 2 outbound lanes on the east side of the median; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with median and unused paved width - room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two long dock banks on the south faces (~40-50 doors each) plus west-face and north-face docks; total well over 100 doors -> 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards north of the west building, west end, and along the south yard - dozens of parked trailers without tractors -> 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on multiple building faces (south, west, north) suggest separated ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the dense Boynton Beach / Palm Beach metro fabric (residential, school, I-95, adjacent industrial parks) -> Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Dense metro location, strong cellular coverage expected -> false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two large connected building masses (tan-roof west, white-roof east) read as 2 structures.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs east of the site beyond I-95 but no spur enters the Publix property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~68 acres computed from the traced perimeter polygon (fenced property only, excludes adjacent school/industrial).
